"""miner_1 2027-07-01 datacheck: live cross-section, recent regime stats."""
import json, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from miner_3_20261203_common import WATCH, load_prices, load_macro

ASOF = '2027-06-30'
px = load_prices(ASOF)
macro = load_macro(ASOF)

print("=== Recent closes & liveness ===")
last = px.index[-1]
for s in WATCH:
    v = px[s].dropna()
    if len(v) == 0:
        print(f"{s:10s} NO DATA"); continue
    last_date = v.index[-1]
    n_stale = (last - last_date).days
    ret10 = v.iloc[-1] / v.iloc[-11] - 1 if len(v) > 11 else np.nan
    ret21 = v.iloc[-1] / v.iloc[-22] - 1 if len(v) > 22 else np.nan
    vol20 = v.pct_change().tail(20).std() * np.sqrt(252) if len(v) > 21 else np.nan
    flag = 'FROZEN' if n_stale > 5 else 'live'
    print(f"{s:10s} last={str(last_date.date()):12s} stale_d={n_stale:4d} ret10={ret10:+.3f} ret21={ret21:+.3f} vol20_ann={vol20:.2f} [{flag}]")

print("\n=== Macro last values ===")
for c in macro.columns:
    v = macro[c].dropna()
    if len(v):
        r10 = v.iloc[-1] / v.iloc[-11] - 1 if len(v) > 11 else np.nan
        print(f"{c:8s} last={v.iloc[-1]:.4f} ret10={r10:+.4f}")

print("\n=== Cross-sectional dispersion of 10d returns (live only) ===")
live = [s for s in WATCH if (px.index[-1] - px[s].dropna().index[-1]).days <= 5]
r10 = (px[live].iloc[-1] / px[live].iloc[-11] - 1).dropna()
print("n_live:", len(live), "assets:", live)
print("dispersion (std of r10):", round(r10.std(), 4))
print(r10.sort_values().round(4).to_string())

<｜DSML｜parameter name="content" string="true">"""miner_1 2028-05-04: screen batch of 12 novel factor candidates.
Visible-through: 2028-05-03 (date.json). Arena: 15-asset cross-asset universe.
Candidate families: vol-scaled momentum, trend confirmation, 200d SMA distance,
drawdown depth, skewness, vol term-structure, cross-asset betas (HSI/SPX/COPPER/USDJPY/N225/EURUSD),
and Commodity Channel Index.
Output: scripts/_miner1_20280504_screen_results.json
"""
import sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from miner_1_20280504_common import WATCH, load_prices, load_macro, vseries, retk, cross_sectional_ic, ic_stats, spearman_panel_rho, regime_split

ASOF = '2028-05-03'
H = 10
px = load_prices(ASOF)
macro = load_macro(ASOF)
INDEX = px.index

def build_panel(fn):
    cols = {}
    for s in WATCH:
        try:
            cols[s] = fn(s, px[s])
        except Exception:
            cols[s] = np.nan
    return pd.DataFrame(cols).sort_index().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

def fwd_panel(h):
    out = {}
    for s in WATCH:
        v = vseries(px[s])
        out[s] = (v.shift(-h) / v - 1.0).reindex(INDEX)
    return pd.DataFrame(out).sort_index()

def rolling_beta(y, x, w=60, minp=None):
    """rolling beta of y returns on x returns, reindexed to y's index."""
    ry, rx = vseries(y).pct_change(), vseries(x).pct_change()
    df = pd.concat([ry.rename('y'), rx.rename('x')], axis=1, sort=True).dropna()
    if minp is None:
        minp = max(6, int(w * 0.4))
    cov = df['y'].rolling(w, min_periods=minp).cov(df['x'])
    var = df['x'].rolling(w, min_periods=minp).var()
    return (cov / var).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)

def vol_series(s, w=20):
    return vseries(s).pct_change().rolling(w).std().reindex(INDEX)

# ---- factor builders ----
def f_vol_adj_mom_20(s, p):
    m = retk(p, 20)
    v = p.pct_change().rolling(20).std()
    return (m / v).reindex(INDEX)

def f_trend_confirm_20x60(s, p):
    m20 = retk(p, 20)
    m60 = retk(p, 60)
    out = pd.Series(0.0, index=m20.index)
    out[(m20 > 0) & (m60 > 0)] = 1.0
    out[(m20 < 0) & (m60 < 0)] = -1.0
    # neutral when disagreement / flat
    out[(m20.abs() < 1e-12) | (m60.abs() < 1e-12)] = 0.0
    return out.reindex(INDEX)

def f_dist_200sma(s, p):
    v = vseries(p)
    sma = v.rolling(200).mean()
    return ((v / sma) - 1.0).reindex(INDEX)

def f_drawdown_60(s, p):
    v = vseries(p)
    mx = v.rolling(60).max()
    return ((v / mx) - 1.0).reindex(INDEX)

def f_skew_120(s, p):
    r = vseries(p).pct_change()
    return r.rolling(120).skew().reindex(INDEX)

def f_vol_ratio_20_60(s, p):
    v20 = p.pct_change().rolling(20).std()
    v60 = p.pct_change().rolling(60).std()
    return (v20 / v60).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)

# betas
hsi = px['HSI']; spx = px['SPX']; cop = px['COPPER']
jp = macro['USDJPY']; n225 = px['N225']; eur = macro['EURUSD']

def f_hsi_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, hsi, 60)
def f_spx_beta_20(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, spx, 20)
def f_copper_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, cop, 60)
def f_usdjpy_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, jp, 60)
def f_n225_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, n225, 60)
def f_eurusd_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, eur, 60)

def f_cci_20(s, p):
    v = vseries(p)
    tp = v  # use close as typical price (no separate high/low needed per asset; simpler)
    ma = tp.rolling(20).mean()
    md = tp.rolling(20).apply(lambda x: np.mean(np.abs(x - x.mean())), raw=True)
    cci = (tp - ma) / (0.015 * md).replace(0, np.nan)
    return cci.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)

FACTORS = {
    'vol_adj_mom_20': f_vol_adj_mom_20,
    'trend_confirm_20x60': f_trend_confirm_20x60,
    'dist_200sma': f_dist_200sma,
    'drawdown_60': f_drawdown_60,
    'skew_120': f_skew_120,
    'vol_ratio_20_60': f_vol_ratio_20_60,
    'hsi_beta_60': f_hsi_beta_60,
    'spx_beta_20': f_spx_beta_20,
    'copper_beta_60': f_copper_beta_60,
    'usdjpy_beta_60': f_usdjpy_beta_60,
    'n225_beta_60': f_n225_beta_60,
    'cci_20': f_cci_20,
}

fwd10 = fwd_panel(H)
panels = {k: build_panel(fn) for k, fn in FACTORS.items()}

# reference library panels for correlation check: active factors + ensemble fallback
lib_refs = {}
# flip_mom_20x10
def _flip_mom_20x10(s, p):
    return (retk(p, 20) * np.sign(retk(p, 10))).reindex(INDEX)
lib_refs['flip_mom_20x10'] = build_panel(_flip_mom_20x10)
# usdcny_beta_60
usdcny = macro['USDCNY']
lib_refs['usdcny_beta_60'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: rolling_beta(p, usdcny, 60))
# mom_10d_skip5
lib_refs['mom_10d_skip5'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: (retk(p, 15) - retk(p, 5)).reindex(INDEX))
# vix_beta_cond_60x20
vix = macro['VIX']
cond_vix = (vix.pct_change().rolling(20).sum() > 0).reindex(px.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
def _rb_cond(y, x, w=60, cond=None):
    ry, rx = vseries(y).pct_change(), vseries(x).pct_change()
    df = pd.concat([ry.rename('y'), rx.rename('x')], axis=1, sort=True).dropna()
    c = cond.reindex(df.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    cov = df['y'].where(c).rolling(w, min_periods=24).cov(df['x'].where(c))
    var = df['x'].where(c).rolling(w, min_periods=24).var()
    return (cov / var).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)
lib_refs['vix_beta_cond_60x20'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: _rb_cond(p, vix, 60, cond_vix))
# yield_beta_cond_60x20 (US10Y)
us10 = px['US10Y']
cond_us10 = (us10.pct_change().rolling(20).sum() > 0).reindex(px.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
lib_refs['yield_beta_cond_60x20'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: _rb_cond(p, us10, 60, cond_us10))

print("panels built. lib refs:", list(lib_refs.keys()))

result = {}
for name, f in panels.items():
    icd = cross_sectional_ic(f, fwd10)
    st = ic_stats(icd)
    if st['n_dates'] == 0:
        result[name] = {'flag': 'fail', 'error': 'no IC dates'}
        continue
    # recent 252d
    icr = icd[icd.index >= icd.index[-1] - pd.Timedelta(days=252)]
    st_r = ic_stats(icr)
    # turnover
    ranks = f.rank(axis=1)
    to10 = float(ranks.diff(10).abs().mean().mean() / (len(WATCH) - 1)) if len(f) > 10 else np.nan
    # coverage
    cov_all = float(f.notna().mean().mean())
    cov_252 = float(f.tail(252).notna().mean().mean())
    # decay
    decay = {}
    for hh in [1, 2, 5, 10, 20]:
        icd_h = cross_sectional_ic(f, fwd_panel(hh))
        decay[hh] = round(float(icd_h['ic'].mean()) if len(icd_h) else np.nan, 4)
    # regime
    reg = regime_split(icd)
    # library corr
    rho_lib = {}

<｜DSML｜parameter name="content" string="true">"""miner_1 2028-05-04: screen batch of 12 novel factor candidates.
Visible-through: 2028-05-03 (date.json). Arena: 15-asset cross-asset universe.
Candidate families: vol-scaled momentum, trend confirmation, 200d SMA distance,
drawdown depth, skewness, vol term-structure, cross-asset betas (HSI/SPX/COPPER/USDJPY/N225/EURUSD),
and Commodity Channel Index.
Output: scripts/_miner1_20280504_screen_results.json
"""
import sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from miner_1_20280504_common import WATCH, load_prices, load_macro, vseries, retk, cross_sectional_ic, ic_stats, spearman_panel_rho, regime_split

ASOF = '2028-05-03'
H = 10
px = load_prices(ASOF)
macro = load_macro(ASOF)
INDEX = px.index

def build_panel(fn):
    cols = {}
    for s in WATCH:
        try:
            cols[s] = fn(s, px[s])
        except Exception:
            cols[s] = np.nan
    return pd.DataFrame(cols).sort_index().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

def fwd_panel(h):
    out = {}
    for s in WATCH:
        v = vseries(px[s])
        out[s] = (v.shift(-h) / v - 1.0).reindex(INDEX)
    return pd.DataFrame(out).sort_index()

def rolling_beta(y, x, w=60, minp=None):
    """rolling beta of y returns on x returns, reindexed to y's index."""
    ry, rx = vseries(y).pct_change(), vseries(x).pct_change()
    df = pd.concat([ry.rename('y'), rx.rename('x')], axis=1, sort=True).dropna()
    if minp is None:
        minp = max(6, int(w * 0.4))
    cov = df['y'].rolling(w, min_periods=minp).cov(df['x'])
    var = df['x'].rolling(w, min_periods=minp).var()
    return (cov / var).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)

def vol_series(s, w=20):
    return vseries(s).pct_change().rolling(w).std().reindex(INDEX)

# ---- factor builders ----
def f_vol_adj_mom_20(s, p):
    m = retk(p, 20)
    v = p.pct_change().rolling(20).std()
    return (m / v).reindex(INDEX)

def f_trend_confirm_20x60(s, p):
    m20 = retk(p, 20)
    m60 = retk(p, 60)
    out = pd.Series(0.0, index=m20.index)
    out[(m20 > 0) & (m60 > 0)] = 1.0
    out[(m20 < 0) & (m60 < 0)] = -1.0
    # neutral when disagreement / flat
    out[(m20.abs() < 1e-12) | (m60.abs() < 1e-12)] = 0.0
    return out.reindex(INDEX)

def f_dist_200sma(s, p):
    v = vseries(p)
    sma = v.rolling(200).mean()
    return ((v / sma) - 1.0).reindex(INDEX)

def f_drawdown_60(s, p):
    v = vseries(p)
    mx = v.rolling(60).max()
    return ((v / mx) - 1.0).reindex(INDEX)

def f_skew_120(s, p):
    r = vseries(p).pct_change()
    return r.rolling(120).skew().reindex(INDEX)

def f_vol_ratio_20_60(s, p):
    v20 = p.pct_change().rolling(20).std()
    v60 = p.pct_change().rolling(60).std()
    return (v20 / v60).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)

# betas
hsi = px['HSI']; spx = px['SPX']; cop = px['COPPER']
jp = macro['USDJPY']; n225 = px['N225']; eur = macro['EURUSD']

def f_hsi_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, hsi, 60)
def f_spx_beta_20(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, spx, 20)
def f_copper_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, cop, 60)
def f_usdjpy_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, jp, 60)
def f_n225_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, n225, 60)
def f_eurusd_beta_60(s, p): return rolling_beta(p, eur, 60)

def f_cci_20(s, p):
    v = vseries(p)
    tp = v  # use close as typical price (no separate high/low needed per asset; simpler)
    ma = tp.rolling(20).mean()
    md = tp.rolling(20).apply(lambda x: np.mean(np.abs(x - x.mean())), raw=True)
    cci = (tp - ma) / (0.015 * md).replace(0, np.nan)
    return cci.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)

FACTORS = {
    'vol_adj_mom_20': f_vol_adj_mom_20,
    'trend_confirm_20x60': f_trend_confirm_20x60,
    'dist_200sma': f_dist_200sma,
    'drawdown_60': f_drawdown_60,
    'skew_120': f_skew_120,
    'vol_ratio_20_60': f_vol_ratio_20_60,
    'hsi_beta_60': f_hsi_beta_60,
    'spx_beta_20': f_spx_beta_20,
    'copper_beta_60': f_copper_beta_60,
    'usdjpy_beta_60': f_usdjpy_beta_60,
    'n225_beta_60': f_n225_beta_60,
    'cci_20': f_cci_20,
}

fwd10 = fwd_panel(H)
panels = {k: build_panel(fn) for k, fn in FACTORS.items()}

# reference library panels for correlation check: active factors + ensemble fallback
lib_refs = {}
# flip_mom_20x10
def _flip_mom_20x10(s, p):
    return (retk(p, 20) * np.sign(retk(p, 10))).reindex(INDEX)
lib_refs['flip_mom_20x10'] = build_panel(_flip_mom_20x10)
# usdcny_beta_60
usdcny = macro['USDCNY']
lib_refs['usdcny_beta_60'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: rolling_beta(p, usdcny, 60))
# mom_10d_skip5
lib_refs['mom_10d_skip5'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: (retk(p, 15) - retk(p, 5)).reindex(INDEX))
# vix_beta_cond_60x20
vix = macro['VIX']
cond_vix = (vix.pct_change().rolling(20).sum() > 0).reindex(px.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
def _rb_cond(y, x, w=60, cond=None):
    ry, rx = vseries(y).pct_change(), vseries(x).pct_change()
    df = pd.concat([ry.rename('y'), rx.rename('x')], axis=1, sort=True).dropna()
    c = cond.reindex(df.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    cov = df['y'].where(c).rolling(w, min_periods=24).cov(df['x'].where(c))
    var = df['x'].where(c).rolling(w, min_periods=24).var()
    return (cov / var).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).reindex(INDEX)
lib_refs['vix_beta_cond_60x20'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: _rb_cond(p, vix, 60, cond_vix))
# yield_beta_cond_60x20 (US10Y)
us10 = px['US10Y']
cond_us10 = (us10.pct_change().rolling(20).sum() > 0).reindex(px.index).fillna(False).astype(bool)
lib_refs['yield_beta_cond_60x20'] = build_panel(lambda s, p: _rb_cond(p, us10, 60, cond_us10))

print("panels built. lib refs:", list(lib_refs.keys()))

result = {}
for name, f in panels.items():
    icd = cross_sectional_ic(f, fwd10)
    st = ic_stats(icd)
    if st['n_dates'] == 0:
        result[name] = {'flag': 'fail', 'error': 'no IC dates'}
        continue
    # recent 252d
    icr = icd[icd.index >= icd.index[-1] - pd.Timedelta(days=252)]
    st_r = ic_stats(icr)
    # turnover
    ranks = f.rank(axis=1)
    to10 = float(ranks.diff(10).abs().mean().mean() / (len(WATCH) - 1)) if len(f) > 10 else np.nan
    # coverage
    cov_all = float(f.notna().mean().mean())
    cov_252 = float(f.tail(252).notna().mean().mean())
    # decay
    decay = {}
    for hh in [1, 2, 5, 10, 20]:
        icd_h = cross_sectional_ic(f, fwd_panel(hh))
        decay[hh] = round(float(icd_h['ic'].mean()) if len(icd_h) else np.nan, 4)
    # regime
    reg = regime_split(icd)
    # library corr
    rho_lib = {}
    for lk, lp in lib_refs.items():
        rho_lib[lk] = round(spearman_panel_rho(f, lp), 4) if spearman_panel_rho(f, lp) == spearman_panel_rho(f, lp) else None
    maxrho = round(max([abs(v) for v in rho_lib.values() if v is not None] or [0.0]), 4)
    # gate: |IC| >= 0.007, |ICIR| >= 0.084, recent252 same sign, maxrho < 0.6
    gate_ic = abs(st['ic']) >= 0.007
    gate_icir = abs(st['icir']) >= 0.084
    gate_sign = (st['ic'] > 0) == (st_r['ic'] > 0) if st_r['n_dates'] > 0 else False
    gate_rho = maxrho < 0.6
    flag = 'PASS' if (gate_ic and gate_icir and gate_sign and gate_rho) else 'fail'
    result[name] = {
        'ic': round(float(st['ic']), 4), 'icir': round(float(st['icir']), 4),
        'hit': round(float(st['hit']), 4), 'n_dates': int(st['n_dates']),
        'avg_n': round(float(st.get('avg_n', np.nan)), 2),
        'ic_recent252': round(float(st_r['ic']), 4) if st_r['n_dates'] else None,
        'icir_recent252': round(float(st_r['icir']), 4) if st_r['n_dates'] else None,
        'n_recent': int(st_r['n_dates']),
        'turnover_10d': round(to10, 4) if to10 == to10 else None,
        'coverage_asset_days': round(cov_all, 4),
        'coverage_last_252d': round(cov_252, 4),
        'decay': {str(k): v for k, v in decay.items()},
        'regime': reg,
        'rho_lib': rho_lib,
        'max_lib_rho': maxrho,
        'gate_ic': gate_ic, 'gate_icir': gate_icir, 'gate_sign': gate_sign, 'gate_rho': gate_rho,
        'flag': flag,
    }
    print(f"{name:20s} ic={st['ic']:.4f} icir={st['icir']:.4f} hit={st['hit']:.3f} n={st['n_dates']:5d} "
          f"rec252={st_r['ic']:.4f} to10={to10:.3f} cov={cov_all:.3f} maxrho={maxrho:.3f} -> {flag}")

with open('scripts/_miner1_20280504_screen_results.json', 'w') as fp:
    json.dump(result, fp, indent=1, default=str)
print("\nWrote scripts/_miner1_20280504_screen_results.json")
